admin.title: Admin
admin.subtitle: Run the center: staff, syllabus, AI models and budgets.
admin.adminOnly: The admin panel is for center admins. Your work happens in the app.

members.title: Staff
members.subtitle: Give teachers and staff their own login, the subjects they teach and an AI budget.
members.passwordHint: Leave it empty and one is made for you.
members.credentialsBody: This password won't be shown again. Send it to them privately, for example on WhatsApp.
members.resetBody: They'll be signed out on every device and will need this password to sign in again.
members.removeBody: They'll be signed out right away and won't be able to sign in. You can add them again later.
members.adminOnly: Only center admins can manage staff.
members.head: Head
members.editBody: Subjects are where their papers and searches start by default; they can still use any subject.
members.ownRole: You can't change your own role. Ask another admin.
members.headHint: Head of department: reviews that subject's questions and sees its AI usage.
members.noSubjectsYet: No subjects yet. They come from the syllabus (Admin → Exams & syllabus).
members.budgetHint: Leave empty and only the center's budget applies.

permissions.title: Roles & permissions
permissions.subtitle: What each role can do. Roles are fixed; give each person the role that fits their work.

chat.use: Use the chat (ask doubts, create material)

question.approve: Approve questions into the question bank

library.review: Check and correct text read from scans
library.process: Run paid AI work on content: OCR, questions from papers, topics

syllabus.manage: Manage exams, syllabus and paper patterns

ai.manage: Manage AI models, routes and prompts

syllabus.title: Exams & syllabus
syllabus.subtitle: The syllabus tree every paper, search and upload is tagged with, and the exam papers that use it.
syllabus.pickSubject: Pick a subject to see its tree.
syllabus.codeHint: Lowercase English words joined by _, e.g. rotational_motion. It can't be changed later.
syllabus.aliasesHint: One per line, e.g. newton ke niyam
syllabus.activeHint: Switch off to retire a node; content already tagged with it keeps its tag.
syllabus.noExams: No exam papers yet. Import them from a JSON file.
syllabus.deleteBody: Its paper patterns are deleted too. Papers already made for it keep their content.

patterns.title: Paper patterns
patterns.subtitle: How each exam paper is set: sections, question types, marks, negative marking and time. The chat plans papers from these.
patterns.noExams: No exam papers yet. Add them under Exams & syllabus.
patterns.noPatterns: No patterns for this paper yet.
patterns.retireBody: It disappears from the list and from the chat. Papers already made from it keep it.
patterns.attemptAnyHint: Leave empty when all are compulsory.
patterns.mixMustAdd: Easy, medium and hard must add up to 100%.
patterns.editorBody: Saving creates a new version; papers already made keep the version they used.
patterns.name: Pattern name

center.title: Center profile
center.subtitle: How your center appears on exported papers, and the AI rules for your teachers.
center.headerHint: Address, phone, tagline. One per line.
center.instructionsHint: Added to every paper unless the paper pattern has its own.
center.logoHint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 1 MB. Printed at the top of every export.
center.models: Models teachers can choose in the chat
center.modelsHint: None ticked means every model the platform allows. Admins can always use all of them.
center.crossCheck: Check answers with the other AI provider
center.crossCheckHint: Before a question counts as verified, the other provider solves it without seeing the answer.
center.sourcing: Where questions come from by default

sourcingOptions.bank_first: Question bank first, then generate the rest

aiModels.title: AI models
aiModels.subtitle: Which AI models are available, which model does each job for your center, and whether provider keys are set.
aiModels.engineDown: The AI engine isn't answering, so key status is unknown.
aiModels.stubActive: The built-in test model is answering. Everything works end to end, but answers are placeholders until a provider key is added.
aiModels.keysHint: Keys are kept only by the AI engine (never in the browser or the database). Your developer adds them to the server settings.
aiModels.registryReadOnly: Only the platform admin can switch models on or off.
aiModels.routesHint: Each job uses the platform's default model unless your center chooses another.

prompts.title: Prompts
prompts.subtitle: The instructions the AI follows for each job, kept as versions per model family. Only the live version is used.
prompts.readOnly: Prompts are shared by every center; only the platform admin can write or switch them.
prompts.noVersions: No prompt yet for this job. It is written when the job is built.
prompts.editorHint: Placeholders like '{{first_message}}' are filled in when the prompt is used; keep the same ones.
prompts.saved: Saved as version {version}. Make it live when you're ready.

usage.title: Usage & budgets
usage.subtitle: What AI use cost this month, who and what it was for, and the center's monthly limit.
usage.budgetHint: A monthly ceiling for the whole center. Teachers' own budgets are set under Staff.
usage.none: No AI use in this month yet.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.subtitle: Every change an admin made in this center, newest first.

ai.route_set: Chose a model for a job
ai.route_clear: Reset a job to the default model

content.title: Content
content.subtitle: Work on the library that needs an AI model: reading scanned pages, splitting question papers into questions, and tagging content with syllabus topics. Nothing is sent to a model until you run it.
content.unreachableTitle: The AI engine can't be reached
content.unreachableBody: What is waiting, and what it would cost, shows again once it is running.
content.stubTitle: No AI key yet: the built-in test model answers
content.stubBody: Runs are free and finish at once, so everything can be tried. The test model can't read scanned pages, so those keep waiting until a key is added under AI models.

ocr.title: Read scanned pages
ocr.body: Scans, and pages whose Hindi couldn't be read, are read from their page images by a vision model.

segment.title: Split papers into questions
segment.body: Question papers are split into their questions in Hindi and English, given the answers from their keys, and added to the question bank.

tag.title: Pick syllabus topics
tag.body: Passages and questions tagged with a chapter get the topics inside it, so teachers can choose by topic.

runs.running: Started {when}. Results arrive in the background.
runs.completed: The last run, started {when}, has finished.
runs.failed: The last run, started {when}, failed. The job runner shows why.

content.batchNote: Runs use the providers' Batch API at half price. Results arrive within minutes, and at most within 24 hours; this page updates as they do.
content.confirmBody: {items} {unit}, sent to {model}. Estimated cost {cost}, counted against the center's AI budget.
content.limitHint: Try a few first to check the results; the rest stay waiting.

problems.title: Recent problems
problems.description: What failed in the last 24 hours. Checked every minute.
problems.none: Nothing failed in the last day.
